description: Search, run and build the workflows you have exposed to MCP on your own n8n Cloud or self-hosted…

instance_host.description: Host name of your n8n instance (n8n Cloud or self-hosted), without https:// or a path. The full Server URL is shown under Settings > Instance-level MCP > Connect a client. (for example: acme.app.n8n.cloud)

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Personal MCP access token: Settings > Instance-level MCP > Connect a client > API key tab. Paste the generated token as is. Enter it as: Bearer <value>
